name: Hellfire Imps summoned by Implosion attack combat enemies without owner auto-attack (#13736)
contract: Implosion 524897 is an AoE Demonfire spender that damages enemies within 10 yd and summons 1 + consumed Demonfire Hellfire Imps (50301). Casting Implosion puts hit enemies into combat with the knight without turning on the knight's melee auto-attack (player->GetVictim() stays null). Previously npc_ascension_xoroth_summon::UpdateAI only inspected player->GetVictim() and ran CreatureAI::UpdateVictim() on 50301, so imps summoned by Implosion stood behind the knight in follow formation instead of attacking enemies engaged with the knight. Now UpdateAI falls back to player->getAttackerForHelper(), me->getAttackerForHelper() and player->GetCombatManager().GetAnyTarget() and skips CreatureAI::UpdateVictim() for 50301. A level-43 knight casts Implosion with 2 Demonfire near a level-43 enemy without starting auto-attack, verifies 3 imps spawn and the knight records 0 melee hits, and verifies the imps alone reduce the enemy's health after the initial Implosion blast.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

CONTRACT: Implosion Hellfire Imps attack and damage the enemy
